scenario_description: The identical hostile workload rejects a deliberately inherited network boundary.
expected: Baseline behavior still passes, isolating the difference to the execution boundary.
The unsafe arm uses the same non-root Docker-exec workload boundary as the isolated arm.
At least one egress attempt succeeds and the hostile assertion exits nonzero.
The following sentinel is not run and cleanup is still confirmed.
observed: The same unittest and add_one(41)=42 baseline passed through the same non-root Docker-exec timeout boundary and fixed environment.
With inherited networking, direct and DNS egress became true and the exact hostile assertion exited one.
The following sentinel was not run, the host snapshot matched, and SWE-ReX cleanup left no container.
notes: PASS means the control detected the deliberately unsafe network; the unsafe workload itself failed as designed.
